description: Angular component for a value card widget in the Thingsboard UI, handling display and resizing of a value card with icon, label, date, and background styling.

classes.name: ValueCardWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for rendering a customizable value card widget with dynamic styling, data updates, and resize handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes widget settings, styles, and data bindings based on context and parameters.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up resize observer and initial sizing after view initialization.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Disconnects resize observer to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Sets border radius style and triggers change detection.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Updates displayed value, date, and colors based on latest data.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Calculates scale and adjusts size of the widget based on container dimensions.
